_comment: F3 self-refresh: the loader atomically replaces this WHOLE file with the own-repo copy when that copy's last_verified is strictly newer (bounded to today+1d). Manual local edits MUST bump last_verified — a newer repo copy overwrites uncommitted local edits by design. claude-fable-5-1 carries the litellm-fetched rate (overlay fetched 2026-09-01, cache_read 0.25), NOT a vendor quote and NOT the claude-fable-5 family rate whose cache_read is 1.0 — a SoT row wins over the overlay, so this row pins the fetched value and only an operator edit can move it. Two consequences of adding the row: (a) the id flips unknown->is_known, so backfill-cost-events.py --reprice now rewrites stored core.cost_events rows for it at this rate retroactively (calc_cost keys on each row's event_date and this row declares no tiers); (b) the last_verified bump re-stamps the WHOLE file, suppressing cost-tracker.sh's stale advisory for every other row until 2026-12-01 (stale_after_days 90) though only this row was touched.
